name: How do I prepare my home for a major remodeling project?

mainEntity.name: How do I prepare my home for a major remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preparing your home for a major remodel involves several steps. Start by decluttering and packing away personal items, especially from areas being renovated, to protect them from dust and damage. Create a clear path for workers and materials, and consider setting up a temporary living zone if essential areas like the kitchen or bathroom will be inaccessible. Discuss with your contractor about utility shut-offs, waste disposal, and any specific requests they have for site preparation to ensure a smooth start.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare for a remodel by decluttering, protecting valuables, clearing pathways, and discussing utility needs and site preparation with your contractor.
